title: 第十二章：疯狂的肉肉
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

就在这个时候一群年青人忍不住了，他们走到正吃着欢的苏行枫几个人那问：

“老板，你们这肉这么香怎么卖啊？”

为首的一个年青人问道着，眼睛还不停的看向那桌上的菜，跟在他后面的人也一样，一副好像没吃过肉的样子。

“你们好，你们是要吃饭是吧？我们这个肉是鹿肉，单独不出售的，只要在这吃就行，现在定价是三百元一斤，你们要多少自己点，我们帮你加工成菜式”

这个时候何大哥发挥了一家之主的作用，把话说得很圆滑，边上的萱姐心里还是没个底，也不知道这么贵有没有人吃，刚才听到这些人问时他还很犹豫，所以这才何大哥主动说出来。

“鹿肉？好像一般的鹿肉也要差不多一百呢！虽然没吃过你们的，但是闻着就想吃，先给我们几个来十斤吧！”

何大哥故意把自己的声音提高，也好让后面的人听到。而这个时候那些人听到后也纷纷表示还可以，可以接受这价格，然后大家口口相传。

这下不说还好，一说出去街边上的那些人全听到了，这个时候一窝蜂的找到桌子坐下来，点着菜，指明要多少多少斤肉。

“老板3号桌这边来五斤”

“老板7号桌给我来三斤”

“这边来六斤”

“还有这......”

这还没一会夜摊桌全满了，萱姐，何大哥和嫂子，就连苏行枫自己都上阵了，在那拿着点菜单写着记着。一共二十多桌几个人走来走去的。

“行枫，这边的肉好像不够啊！现在合计起来要一百多斤呢！”

“萱姐，没事儿，我这就回去拿来，你这边先做着，每个桌子先上小部份，别让大家等急了”

他自己回去拿肉，萱姐他们几个就在那开始忙了，等这边他把肉提出来后，那边桌上也上了几个菜到客人那了，吃过的人都说好，全在那大口口的吃着。

“老板，好了没啊，我们都等了好一会了呀！能不能先上一点我们尝尝呀”

“对啊，老板看着别人吃，我这都流口水了都！”

“哈哈！我这都在吞口水解馋呢！”

“各位，今天这些肉刚到，很是新鲜，因为不知道大家喜欢不喜欢，所以我们这也没请太多人，所以怠慢之处还请谅解！”

苏行枫看着他们这么人，听着他们所说的话，他站了出来大声的说了几句。还好的是这些人的素质都还好，不会在那大呼小叫的。

“萱姐，你先休息一下，你的手还没好，你先去把我给你的药先喝下去一些，那药效果很好的，马上就可以见效的。”

“好的，那这边辛苦你了”

他看着萱姐累得满头大汉，脸上还脸色很不好，一看就知道她的手的原因，所以这才让她把那生命水喝下，他自己都不知道那水对她这个手的效果怎么样，但是他还是选择相信长老。

萱姐来到一边，

“这也不像是药啊！不过还挺好喝的......嗯！！难到是心理感觉？这效果有这么好吗？”

他喝下去后就感觉到自己全身的疲劳一扫而空，还充满了力量，把瓶子盖上后自己还活动了一下左手，没有那种痛感了，然后不可思议的再用力晃动了一下自己的手。

“嘿！真不痛了，这真是太神奇了”

她又拿出那个瓶子看了看，像是宝贝一样装回自己的包中，然后还藏起来，站起身后看向苏行枫一脸的感动，心理一阵的莫明。

“萱姐，怎么样了？”

“谢谢你行枫，你那药真好，我现在手好像完全好了，你看！”

她边说还边摇晃着自己的左手。

“那就好，只要没事就行，不过你自己把握着，要是还没好的话晚上回去再用那药擦一个受伤的地方”

“嗯，好的”

聊天两句后又开始忙了起来，这的客人越晚就越多，他回出租屋里来回了几次，把肉提出来，这都第五次了每次都一百多斤，直到收摊了这人还来，要不是大家太累了这都还想一直做下去，把东西收拾了一下四个人累得瘫坐在那。

过了好一会，萱姐拿着菜单在那算了起来，最后一统计一个晚上六百多斤肉全出售光了，到最后没有其它菜，上的全是炒肉，客人还一点都不嫌弃。以前客人吃的菜都还有剩下的，可是今天刷盘子都很轻松，那是客人把盘子都添的光光的。

“行枫，今天一共卖出去了635斤，真不敢想像啊！”

Page (1/3)

At this moment, a group of young people couldn't bear it any longer. They walked up to Su Xingfeng and others who were having a good time and asked:

“Boss, why do you sell this meat that tastes so good?”

A young man in the lead asked, his eyes still looking at the dishes on the table. The people following him did the same, looking as if they had never eaten meat.

"Hello, you want to eat, right? Our meat is venison. We don't sell it separately. You just need to eat it here. The current price is three hundred yuan per catty. You can order how much you want, and we will help you process it into dishes."

At this time, Brother He played the role of the head of the family and spoke very tactfully. Sister Xuan next to him still had no idea, and she didn't know if anyone would eat it at such an expensive price. He was still hesitant when he heard these people ask just now, so Brother He took the initiative to speak out.

"Venison? It seems that ordinary venison costs almost a hundred! Although I have never eaten yours, I want to eat it when I smell it. Give us ten kilograms first!"

Brother He deliberately raised his voice so that the people behind could hear him.At this time, after hearing this, those people also said that it was okay and they could accept the price, and then everyone spread the word.

It's okay not to say it now. Once he said it, all the people on the street heard it. At this time, they all found the table and sat down, ordering the dishes and specifying how many kilograms of meat they wanted.

"Boss, please come to table 3 for five pounds."

"Boss, give me three kilograms at table 7."

"Here are six pounds."

"And this..."

Not long after, the night stall tables were all full. Sister Xuan, Brother He and sister-in-law, and even Su Xingfeng himself came to the battle, taking orders and writing down the menus.There were a total of more than 20 tables with several people walking around.

"Xing Feng, there doesn't seem to be enough meat here! Now the total is over a hundred kilograms!"

"Sister Xuan, it's okay. I'll go back and get it right away. You can do it here first. Serve small portions to each table first. Don't keep everyone waiting."

He went back to get the meat himself, and Sister Xuan and the others started busy there. After he took out the meat, several dishes were served to the guests on the table over there. Everyone who had eaten agreed, and they all ate there.

"Boss, are you okay? We've been waiting for a long time! Can you serve some for us to try first?"

"Yes, the boss is watching other people eating, and my mouth is watering!"

"Haha! I'm just swallowing my saliva to satisfy my craving!"

"Everyone, the meat just arrived today. It's very fresh. We don't know if you like it or not, so we didn't invite too many people here, so please forgive me for the slightness!"

Su Xingfeng looked at them and listened to what they said. He stood up and said a few words loudly.Fortunately, these people are of good quality and won't make any fuss.

"Sister Xuan, take a rest first. Your hand is not healed yet. Go ahead and drink some of the medicine I gave you. The medicine is very effective and will be effective immediately."

"Okay, thank you for your hard work here."

He looked at Sister Xuan, who was so tired and had a bad look on her face. He could tell the reason for her hand at a glance, so he asked her to drink the water of life. He himself didn't know the effect of the water on her hand, but he still chose to believe the elder.

Sister Xuan came to the side,

"This doesn't look like medicine! But it tastes pretty good... Hmm!! Is it a psychological feeling? Is the effect so good?"

After he drank it, he felt that all the fatigue in his body had been swept away, and he was still full of strength. After capping the bottle, he moved his left hand, and the pain disappeared. Then he shook his hand incredibly hard.

"Hey! It doesn't hurt anymore. It's amazing."

She took out the bottle again, looked at it, put it back into her bag like a treasure, and then hid it. After standing up, she looked at Su Xingfeng with a moved face, and she felt confused for a while.

"Sister Xuan, how's it going?"

"Thank you Xing Feng, your medicine is really good. My hand seems to be completely healed now, look!"

She shook her left hand as she spoke.

"That's good, as long as everything is fine, but you have to take care of yourself. If it's not fine yet, go back at night and use that medicine to rub an injured area."

"Well, okay"

After chatting for a few words, it started to get busy again. The later the night, the more customers there were. He went back to the rental house several times to take out the meat. This was the fifth time and the meat weighed more than 100 kilograms each time. The man didn't come back until the stall was closed. If everyone hadn't been too tired, they would have wanted to keep doing it. After packing up the things, the four of them sat there tiredly.

After a while, Sister Xuan took the menu and counted it. At last count, more than 600 kilograms of meat were sold out in one night. In the end, there were no other dishes, and all the dishes were served were fried meat. The customers didn't dislike it at all.In the past, there were always leftover dishes from the guests, but today it was easy to wash the dishes because the guests had filled up the dishes.

"Xing Feng, we sold a total of 635 kilograms today. I can't believe it!"
